statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while NQ is closed for the weekend.
recommendation: Tail remains below the blocking threshold; current risk is dominated by geopolitical and energy Stress rather than observed one-way Nasdaq structure.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low as geopolitical Stress intensifies
body: NQ is closed for the weekend, so no live extension, failed-retracement, or session-extreme structure can be observed. Fresh U.S.-Iran sanctions pressure, impaired Strait of Hormuz flows, and renewed Russia-Ukraine escalation keep Stress extreme without constituting an observed pathological Nasdaq price path.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours remained low-Tail throughout the weekend closure. Tail stayed at 16%, while Stress rose from 92% to 96% as geopolitical headlines accumulated without live NQ price-path confirmation.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain inside the weekend futures closure and end before the Sunday 22:00 UTC Globex reopening. Tail stays low; reopening risk rises only conditionally.
